notes.title: RGC Development Journal
notes.content:
[img]http://www.retrogamecrunch.com/shared/images/game-6/boss-process.gif[/img]

Our full development journal is [url=http://www.retrogamecrunch.com/journal]available online![/url]

Retro Game Crunch was created before there was anything like Steam Early Access. We started back in late 2012 and documented the process along the way. We shared our trials and triumphs. Of course, not everything made it into the games:

[img]http://www.retrogamecrunch.com/shared/images/game-6/art/cut-enemies.png[/img] [img]http://retrogamecrunch.com/shared/images/game-2/drill-para-drill.gif[/img]

This journal was originally for the Kickstarter backers, but now it's available for all. Please enjoy.

---

notes.title: Full 7 Game Soundtrack now live (and free!)
notes.content:
The full 7 game soundtrack for Retro Game Crunch is now available!

Includes 90 tracks of authentic chiptunes written by 8bitmatt. Most of these tracks were written using MML and audio was recorded directly from a real Nintendo Entertainment System!

Bonus album included: Music from the three day jam game Beat Drop and, what it eventually turned into, the 4th Retro Game Crunch game Wub-Wub Wescue.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/374260
Alternatively, download the individual albums on 8bitmatt's Band Camp page: http://8bitmatt.bandcamp.com
